# Simulated AIRR object import controls

Generated by `validation/reference/airr_objects.py --write` (validation-only ruamel.yaml
0.18.6); `study.tsv` is a hand-specified four-row table with UMI counts, two modeled cells
and two loci per cell. All cells, memberships and domain-like sequences are constructed.
No actual participant, receptor, biological ancestry, function or antigen reactivity is asserted.

`study.json` and `study.yaml` represent the same evidence; `study.expected.json` is an
independent YAML-node projection. The source-defined two-member Clone is distinct from the
user's active clonotype definition. C002 deliberately has unknown pairing and unresolved
processing/receptor links. `outside-node` has an unassessed external sequence reference.
Large numeric extension values are serialization controls, not biological measurements.

The domain strings resemble variable-domain-length inputs but are not validated full domains.
Their hash is independently calculated using the ordered AIRR formula. No genuine receptor
function is implied by the hash or selected locus labels. See `docs/AIRR-OBJECTS.md` for scope.
